about_the_game:
"Survivors: Alive" is an SLG + RPG set against the backdrop of an environmental crisis, blending building and multiplayer strategy. Players assume the role of an investigation team commander, working alongside fellow investigators to uncover the truth behind the crisis. Using Hope Town as their base, they build and upgrade their base, search for and rescue survivors, recruit unique investigators, develop technology and craft more powerful military equipment, and snipe hidden wanderers. All while uniting with investigation teams from around the world to fight the enemy, hoping for survival in apocalyptic times!

[Explore the Fog, Find Hope in the Unknown]

A gloomy sky, thick fog permeates the air, shrouding it with unknown dangers. Every corner hides a terrifying threat. However, investigators cautiously navigate their way through the crisis, searching for the truth, rescuing the ever-disappearing survivors while sniping the endless stream of wanderers. Here, as the story unfolds, you'll immerse yourself in the crisis and excitement of the apocalypse, and use your own abilities to change the status quo! The dilapidated base continues to grow, infrastructure continues to improve, rescued survivors fulfill their roles, technology continues to advance, and more and more Investigators gather here to work for the future of humanity!

[Combining Troops, Fighting Strategically in Extreme Environments]

In extreme environments, resources are scarce, and everyone is fighting for survival. Both supplies and manpower are hard to come by! As a commander, you must assign Investigators to their respective roles based on their skills and attributes. Whether leading troops into battle or developing the base, it's all up to you to decide! Infantry, cavalry, and spearmen each have different attributes and training difficulties. Faced with constant danger, the decision is yours! Whether to aggressively resist the enemy or to develop cautiously, commanders must balance their resources and respond wisely!

[Building a Home, a Spark Can Start a Prairie Fire]

Wanderers are constantly attacking, so infrastructure must keep up! Farmland, lumberyards, wells, and warehouses are essential! Radio stations, shooting ranges, fighting arenas, horse farms, training grounds, hospitals, libraries, and modification workshops are all needed! The current situation may be grim, but as a Commander, you must believe in yourself and your allies. A single spark can start a prairie fire, and the future lies in our own hands!

[Build Alliances, Fight Together to Defeat Enemies in the Apocalyptic War]

Crisis is everywhere, and everyone needs to unite to survive! Commanders from all over the world must work together as alliances to build outposts and develop bases, eliminate roaming enemies and hidden dangers, seize survival resources, occupy the world's factory, and develop cutting-edge technology!

Faced with this desperate situation, Commander, are you ready? Let us unite commanders from all over the world and fight for humanity's hope!

  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 4 GB available space

  • Processor: Intel Core i5 2500 or AMD FX 6350
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD 6000 / Nvidia GeForce 720 / AMD
